nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']

centers.sort()
print("click centers:",centers)
acts=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in centers]
res=action(acts)
print("board_changed",res.get('board_changed'),"done",res.get('done'),"level_completed",res.get('level_completed'),"game_over",res.get('game_over'))
# report new N count + floodtop
def ncount(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
ft=next((r for r in range(64) if 'p' in a[r]),None)
print("now step",current_frame.step,"Ncount",ncount(current_frame),"floodtop",ft)
</parameter>

nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
centers=[]
for n in nodes:
    if n['color']=='N':
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        centers.append(((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2))
centers.sort()
print("click centers:",centers)
acts=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in centers]
res=action(acts)
print("board_changed",res.get('board_changed'),"done",res.get('done'),"level_completed",res.get('level_completed'),"game_over",res.get('game_over'))
# report new N count + floodtop
def ncount(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
ft=next((r for r in range(64) if 'p' in a[r]),None)
print("now step",current_frame.step,"Ncount",ncount(current_frame),"floodtop",ft)
</parameter>
</function>
